plugins.name: PlantUML Diagrams
plugins.summary: Renders ```plantuml / ```puml fences via the real PlantUML engine (private JRE + plantuml-mit.jar, downloaded on install).

plugins.name: D2 Diagrams
plugins.summary: Renders ```d2 fences with Terrastruct's D2 — modern architecture/system diagrams from a single official binary.

plugins.name: Graphviz / DOT
plugins.summary: Renders ```dot / ```graphviz fences with the official Graphviz engine (checksum-pinned 15.1.0). No portable Linux build exists upstream.

plugins.name: Typst Snippets
plugins.summary: Renders ```typst fences — typeset math/tables/figures without LaTeX. All platforms (Linux/macOS via .tar.xz extraction).

plugins.name: Vega-Lite Charts
plugins.summary: Renders ```vega-lite / ```vegalite JSON chart specs as real data visualizations via the official vl-convert binary.

plugins.name: LilyPond Sheet Music
plugins.summary: Renders ```lilypond / ```ly fences as engraved sheet music (official 2.24.4, checksum-pinned — 2.26.0's Windows build crashes on compile).

plugins.name: WaveDrom Timing Diagrams
plugins.summary: Renders ```wavedrom JSON signal descriptions as digital timing diagrams (private Node.js LTS runtime + wavedrom-cli from npm).

plugins.name: Pandoc File Importer
plugins.summary: Importer (not a diagram renderer): open/drop .rst/.org/.mediawiki/.textile/.docx/.odt/.rtf/.epub files — Pandoc converts them to Markdown on the way in.

plugins.name: Office Capability (Word fidelity)
plugins.summary: Drives the installed Microsoft Word (via NetOffice) for 100%-accurate SmartArt/DrawingML renders, the Word-exact tiled preview, and .docx verification. Requires Microsoft Office; harmless when absent.
